_purpose: EXAMPLE FILE — copy to applicant-profile.json in this same folder and replace every value with your own. applicant-profile.json is gitignored. This is the fast path autofill-agent reads before touching any application form, so it never has to re-parse BACKGROUND.md prose for a field that is already structured here. All values below are fictional.
_why_so_many_name_and_phone_variants: ATS platforms disagree about format and some reject silently. Workday wants a leading zero on the local phone number, Eightfold rejects CJK characters in Legal Name fields, some forms want the country code as a dropdown label rather than a +number. Recording every variant once here is cheaper than rediscovering it mid-application.

legal_name.note: Eightfold rejects CJK in Legal First/Last Name and blames punctuation in the error message — use family_en/given_en there. Workday accepts either.

preferred_name._note: The everyday English name, NOT the romanized legal given name. Eightfold's 'Given Name - Western Script' field wants this one.

contact.note: Workday validates against the country dropdown — pick the dropdown value first, then fill the local number without the leading zero. Some Eightfold forms want it with.

address.line1_en: 5F., No. 101, Sec. 2, Guangfu Rd., East Dist.

address.note: Workday sometimes exposes both 'Address Line 1' and 'Address Line 1 - Chinese'. When both exist, exact-match the label or you will fill the wrong one.

languages.note: Some forms have a single 'I am fluent in this language' checkbox instead of the four sub-ratings.
TOEIC 890 (2024). Some applications ask for a test score in a free-text field — keep the number and year here.

education.field_of_study_note: Plain department names usually exist standalone in Workday's picklist — check before settling for a combined/hybrid option.

work_experience.note: Do NOT dump every entry onto every application. Pick the entries that match what the specific posting asks for — that judgment is per-application and belongs to the agent, not to this file.

entries.role_description_source: Include only when the form has no separate military-service section and would otherwise show an unexplained gap.

application_defaults._note: These are the answers that repeat on almost every application. Recording them here is what stops the agent from re-deriving them (and answering inconsistently) each time.
application_defaults.ai_matching_consent_note: Eightfold asks whether you consent to AI-assisted matching. Decide once, record it here, stay consistent.
application_defaults.note: Anything JD-dependent — e.g. 'do you meet the basic requirements for this role' — is NOT a default. Leave it out of this block; it is a per-application judgment call.

resume.filename_warning: Some ATS surface the uploaded filename to the recruiter verbatim. Name the file something you would be happy for them to read — 'resume_v7_FINAL_fix2.pdf' is a real own-goal.
